data.content:
{
 "component": "qr-code",
 "file": "kit/qr-code.js",
 "about": "Five things a screen hands to a phone. The kit is the same in each; the page decides what the text is and what scanning it does. All addresses and names are invented.",
 "cases": [
  {
   "id": "signer",
   "label": "Signer link",
   "context": "A desk shows a tenant the link to their own signing page, so they sign on their phone.",
   "text": "https://192.0.2.10:8766/s/k3Jd9-xQ2mZ",
   "ecc": "M",
   "title": "Jane Sample signs here",
   "hint": "Open the camera on your phone and point it at the code."
  },
  {
   "id": "wifi",
   "label": "Wi-Fi guest network",
   "context": "A café shows its guest network. Phones join it from the code without typing the password.",
   "text": "WIFI:T:WPA;S:Cafe Guest;P:espresso42;;",
   "ecc": "Q",
   "caption": "Cafe Guest (WPA)",
   "title": "Join Cafe Guest",
   "hint": "Scanning joins the network; the password is in the code."
  },
  {
   "id": "menu",
   "label": "Table menu",
   "context": "A printed card on table 12 opens the menu for that table. Level H survives a coffee stain.",
   "text": "https://menu.example/table/12",
   "ecc": "H",
   "title": "Menu for table 12",
   "hint": "Order from your phone."
  },
  {
   "id": "ticket",
   "label": "Event check-in",
   "context": "A ticket page shows the code the door scanner reads. The text is the ticket number, not a link.",
   "text": "TICKET 2026-0417 ROW F SEAT 12 GATE B",
   "ecc": "L",
   "title": "Your ticket",
   "hint": "Show this at gate B."
  },
  {
   "id": "contact",
   "label": "Contact card",
   "context": "A badge page shares a contact card. Phones offer to save it as a contact.",
   "text": "MECARD:N:Example,Priya;TEL:+15550100;EMAIL:priya@example.org;;",
   "ecc": "M",
   "caption": "Priya Example, contact card",
   "title": "Save Priya as a contact",
   "hint": "Scanning offers to add the contact."
  }
 ]
}

entry.name: QR code
entry.summary: A QR code made in the page for a link or any text: crisp SVG with the text, Copy and a PNG download, a large sheet to scan from, and the encoder alone.
